draft.subject: Getting Summit Labs started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

I know a new tool is easy to put off, so I'll keep this brief. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Summit Labs works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to sit with you while you set up that first project and answer anything as it comes up.

Best,
Priya
